async function craftSixteenJunglePlanks(bot) {
    // This function aims to ensure the bot has at least sixteen jungle planks. It first checks the current count of planks in the inventory and determines how many more are needed. If more are required, it checks if there are enough jungle logs to proceed. If logs are insufficient, it attempts to mine the necessary amount of jungle logs. Finally, it crafts the required number of jungle planks using the available logs and verifies the final count.
}
